decisions.reason: As a flagship new product line close to the core practice software business, it is strategically important, still early, and worth keeping as a low-abandonment option while adoption unfolds.

The education institute fits the installed customer base and can strengthen relationships, but as a more service-like and less central extension than the software core it has a somewhat higher chance of being pruned if uptake is weak.

The remote support tool complements the firm's support and software offering and is likely inexpensive to maintain, so real-options logic favors keeping it on the market while its customer value becomes clearer.
